_comment: Result of merging a (desktop-style, naive UTC) then b (phone-style, Z-suffixed) — the cross-stack timestamp contract (SPEC.md §Timestamps). Zone-less and Z-suffixed spellings of the same instant MUST compare equal: 07-01 desktop wins (10:00:00.5 UTC > 09:00 UTC — a zone-less string is UTC, never local time); 07-02 phone wins (crashed the desktop merge before _parse_dt normalized aware→naive); 07-03 is a tie spelled two different ways — local keeps; 07-04 inserts; 07-05 a newer phone tombstone deletes but keeps local rating/note. Timestamps here are written in the desktop's re-serialized form (naive UTC): the Python test compares byte-for-byte, the JS test compares them as instants (toEpochMs). mood_entries sorted by date.
